Trailer Inspection Forms, Trailer Readiness Forms and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review, because the extraction reads the form's text and the photo captions, not the images. In particular, fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images and cannot be checked from here. Where a form answers "Personal 4 Gas Monitor Calibrated? Yes" but the supporting photo is stale, as on Bobby Fleming's daily, the Yes is recorded but not evidenced by a same-day image.
